entities.name: 499-aa query protein
observations: Sequence length 499 aa; Swiss-Prot search top hit Q0TT95 (AROE_CLOP1) aligns at 36.4% identity across 51.5% of query (E=4.15e-39); other leading hits are also AROE proteins.

Potential shikimate-dehydrogenase-like role is a homology-based hypothesis for the aligned region only; full-query function is unconfirmed because no annotation passed transfer filters and ~half the query is not covered by the top hit.
No query-specific subcellular localization or catalytic reaction was retrieved.

entities.name: UniProt Q0TT95
observations: Reviewed Clostridium perfringens protein annotated as NADP(+)-dependent shikimate dehydrogenase (EC 1.1.1.25); reversibly interconverts 3-dehydroshikimate and shikimate with NADPH/NADP(+).
Annotated in chorismate biosynthesis (step 4/7) and shikimate metabolism; GO cellular component annotation is cytosol (GO:0005829).
Reference homolog is annotated as homodimer; this oligomeric state is not established for the 499-aa query.
